requirements.statement: The client and tool render the typed settings catalog through one accessible draft, preview and apply surface.
acceptance: Mouse, keyboard and gamepad complete apply and cancel at 800x600 and both required UI scales.
Search, category, section or subpage, row detail, dirty draft and transaction actions remain reachable without gameplay input leakage.
The surface distinguishes requested, admitted and effective values, provenance, authority and restart impacts instead of presenting an unlabeled value button.

requirements.statement: The recommended settings foundation supports mechanical rows, declarative subpages and gated specialized editors without allowing package UI code to bypass the shared registry or transaction.
acceptance: A large video-settings fixture composes General, Quality, Performance and Advanced subpages from stable layout declarations while retaining a generic row-list fallback.
A specialized editor is admitted only through a versioned capability with one real consumer, keyboard, mouse, gamepad and accessibility semantics, bounded failure isolation and a generic fallback.
An alternative settings-surface provider must project the complete catalog and pass the same transaction, recovery and accessibility corpus as the official provider.

requirements.statement: Controls exposes every rebindable action from the locked input catalog through searchable device and context groups and one exclusive binding-capture transaction.
acceptance: Every rebindable keyboard or mouse action appears once with its defaults, effective bindings, owning package and reset operation; fixed gamepad mappings remain inspectable.
Capture, replace, clear, cancel, same-context conflict and cross-context reuse produce stable results and preserve the Esc safety fallback.
Binding profile changes apply immediately, persist across process restart and do not leak physical inputs into authoritative gameplay while the surface is open.
